answer: rung0 reproduces E238 exactly (a_share 0.5962, b_agg 0.7706 on 13916 rows), so the grid is not the problem. E240's common-grid pair (A -0.3326, B -0.1742) is one session out of step with its own regressors: of 6640 rows tested, 6635 carry the PREVIOUS session's move (same-session matches 0). Feeding the same increments and the same y through the same routine gives A 0.7909, b_agg 0.5522, i.e. the row restriction alone moves the rest channel from 0.7706 to 0.5522 and nothing here flips a sign. E240's A/B pair is superseded; its dy/dx designs are unaffected because they index both arrays by the same session.
